requirement: Search/read work without a UI, Git, model, credentials, or network.
CLI and MCP return the same IDs, revisions, filters, and errors on equivalent fixtures.
A minimal concept with only `type` conforms; unknown types and fields survive.
notes: QA-01 and QA-02 are fixed in the unreleased source candidate: exact decimals, comments and unchanged spans are covered by real CLI/MCP, move/archive/batch, codec, fuzz and acceptance regressions. The original v0.1.1 distribution remains affected; see docs/evidence/move-fidelity-fix.json.

requirement: Notes without YAML or type are reported as invalid; normal writes reject a nonconformant base. Legacy search or migration is not required.
notes: v0.3.0 adds explicit incremental repair: changed files conform, untouched invalid files remain exact, and blocking errors decrease. Normal writes and default repair remain strict. Search continues indexing valid concepts only.

requirement: Invalid YAML never silently hides notes; status reports how many files could not be parsed.
A single mapping in `verified` is accepted; a content change invalidates active verification.
A timezone-bearing `stale_after` instant is interpreted correctly; incompatible formats are diagnosed.
Search with and without accents retrieves the same expected Portuguese result set.
Body edits preserve YAML comments and untouched fields; a no-op preserves bytes and produces no log entry.
notes: Installed v0.1.2 exposed trailing-comment loss during verification invalidation. The corrected source passes the added LF/CRLF codec/binary-acceptance regressions and all 253 original QA checks; see verification-footer-fix.json. Published v0.1.2 remains affected.

requirement: Of two writes with the same revision, only the first applies; a conflict changes no note, index, or log.
A retry with the same key never duplicates effects, including after failure between publication and response.
Create/edit update the note, index, and log; failures injected at every stage permit recovery.
Move updates resolved Markdown links and anchors without improperly changing ambiguous or external references.
Traversal, symlinks, collisions, and out-of-root files permit neither reading nor writing.
`--read-only` hides and rejects mutations; MCP stdout contains no logs.
Context respects the global ceiling, reports truncation, and provides source lines/revisions.
External-editor changes invalidate cache and revision at the next relevant operation.
Export includes a report and exclusion list; it never claims conformance for unexamined files.
Installation/init never change global configuration or register agents automatically.
Replacing PARA navigation with another hierarchy does not change parsing, identity, or OKF validity of the same files.
A synthetic ingestion creates a source note and updates two existing notes through apply; a conflict in either publishes no changes.
Original snapshot hashes remain unchanged after wiki creation, editing, moving, and plan application.
A synthesis with basis_revisions for two concepts is flagged for review when either changes; it is never automatically rewritten or declared false.
Health identifies an orphan, missing link, concept absent from an index, and changed dependency without claiming deterministic contradiction detection.
An agent-persisted comparison retains provenance; repeating a query without learning creates no note or event.

CLI/MCP operate normally without AGENTS.md inside the base. The target agent consults an external base through CLI + installed skill or independently through MCP initialization/tool guidance; reusable learning is updated and a query without new information does not write. Record observed evidence without promising universal model adherence.
verification_scope: Controlled consumers explicitly used CLI + the installed CLI-only skill and, separately, MCP initialization/tool guidance without the skill, on external bases without AGENTS.md. Both persisted supported learning and repeated queries without Markdown/log changes. Automatic activation across agents is not claimed.
